set -e
src=/mnt/workspace/megatron-lm
lock=/mnt/workspace/.megatron-lm.lock
tmp="/mnt/workspace/.megatron-lm.tmp.$(hostname)"
exec 9>"$lock"
rc=0
flock -w 1200 -E 75 9 || rc=$?
if [ "$rc" -eq 75 ]; then
  echo "Timed out after 1200s waiting for $lock"
  exit 1
elif [ "$rc" -ne 0 ]; then
  echo "Locking $lock failed (exit $rc); preparing without the lock"
fi
rm -rf "$tmp"
if [ -d "$src" ]; then
  echo "Using pre-seeded workspace at $src"
else
  if [ -d /opt/megatron-lm ]; then
    mkdir -p "$tmp"
    rc=0
    timeout 900 cp -a /opt/megatron-lm/. "$tmp" || rc=$?
    if [ "$rc" -eq 124 ]; then
      echo "Copying Megatron-LM from the image timed out after 900s"
      exit 1
    elif [ "$rc" -ne 0 ]; then
      echo "Copying Megatron-LM from the image failed (exit $rc)"
      exit 1
    fi
    how="Copied Megatron-LM from image at /opt/megatron-lm"
  else
    repo="https://git.internal.example.com/mirrors/Megatron-LM.git"
    rc=0
    timeout 900 git clone --depth 1 -b core_v0.15.2 "$repo" "$tmp" || rc=$?
    if [ "$rc" -eq 124 ]; then
      echo "Cloning Megatron-LM timed out after 900s"
      exit 1
    elif [ "$rc" -ne 0 ]; then
      echo "Cloning Megatron-LM failed (exit $rc)"
      exit 1
    fi
    how="Cloned Megatron-LM from the configured source repo"
  fi
  if err=$(mv -T "$tmp" "$src" 2>&1); then
    echo "$how"
  elif [ -d "$src" ]; then
    rm -rf "$tmp"
    echo "Another pod prepared $src first; using it"
  else
    echo "Failed to move $tmp to $src: $err"
    exit 1
  fi
fi
